name: CFDLLMBench
description: CFDLLMBench is a benchmark suite for evaluating large language models on computational fluid dynamics tasks, covering graduate-level CFD knowledge, numerical and physical reasoning, and context-dependent implementation of CFD workflows, with a rigorous evaluation framework for code executability, solution accuracy, and numerical convergence.
reputation: A very recent graduate-level CFD benchmark that is mainly of interest to researchers in scientific code and reasoning, with limited established adoption so far.
notes: Includes three components: CFDQuery, CFDCodeBench, and FoamBench; grounded in real-world CFD practices.
